# rustfs_replication_metrics (Data Source)

Exposes replication transfer metrics (counts, bytes, queue backlog) for a bucket from RustFS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rustfs_replication_metrics" "all" {
  bucket = "my-bucket"
}

output "replication_targets" {
  value = data.rustfs_replication_metrics.all.targets
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Bucket to read replication metrics for.

### Read-Only

- `completed_replication_size` (Number) Total number of bytes replicated for the bucket.
- `failed` (Attributes) Aggregate replication failure counters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--failed))
- `id` (String) Data source identifier.
- `json` (String) Raw JSON response as returned by the RustFS admin API.
- `queued` (Attributes) Replication queue backlog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--queued))
- `replica_count` (Number) Total number of replicas created for the bucket.
- `replica_size` (Number) Total size in bytes of all replicas created for the bucket.
- `replication_count` (Number) Total number of objects replicated for the bucket.
- `targets` (Attributes List) Per-target replication transfer statistics. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))
